mediator_designs.rationale: When both parties delegate, execute the offered terms to guarantee mutual exchange and deter defection. If only one party delegates, cancel to prevent one-sided exploitation and protect against being forced into an unfavorable transfer.
Execute exactly as proposed only when both sides delegate (prevents unilateral coercion). If only one delegates, cancel to avoid opportunistic mediation and protect long-run trade stability.

Allow only fully mutual delegation to proceed (execute fair), but cancel when only one party delegates to prevent unilateral, potentially defection-like advantage; this supports peace and protects both sides.

If both delegate, enforce the offered terms to ensure reliable exchange; if only one delegates, cancel to avoid being exploited under asymmetric delegation while the other side can defect.
Execute fair when both delegate to guarantee the intended exchange; cancel when only one delegates to prevent unilateral exploitation and protect against asymmetric terms.
Fair mutual delegation prevents defection and ensures guaranteed exchange; one-sided delegation is canceled to avoid exploiting the delegator advantage when the other party can defect.
If both parties delegate, enforce the stated terms to prevent defection/hold-up. If only one delegates, cancel to avoid unilateral exploitation and protect against asymmetric incentives.

When both parties delegate, execute_fair ensures guaranteed exchange at offered terms. If only one delegates, cancel prevents one-sided enforcement and discourages defection/gaming, keeping future trading relationships stable.

When both parties delegate, execute exactly as offered to ensure guaranteed simultaneous exchange. When only one delegates, cancel to avoid any one-sided forced outcome that could be exploited given defection incentives.

If both sides delegate, enforce the exact agreed terms to guarantee exchange. If only one side delegates, cancel to avoid one-sided exploitation under asymmetric defection incentives; this keeps mediated trades safe for me.

Use execute_fair when both parties delegate to ensure reliable, simultaneous exchange. If only one party delegates, cancel to prevent one-sided exploitation and protect against strategic defection; also the 1-point fee is only worth it when both sides commit.
Fair execution only when both parties delegate (credible commitment); cancel on one-sided delegation to prevent asymmetric exploitation. Mediation fee is then only paid when exchange is guaranteed.
